subject: [PATCH v3 04/11] mm, swap: support physical swap as a vswap backend

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch adds support for physical swap as a backend for the virtual swap layer (vswap). When zswap declines a page, it allocates a physical slot on demand for swap out. The patch tracks each vswap entry's physical slot via a pointer-tagged swap_table entry and modifies readahead to skip these entries. It also adds writeback of zswap-backed vswap entries to physical swap and reclaim of physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries, which are handled in subsequent patches.
